summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved lists not persisting  **What I found from reading the code (no changes made):**  The backend path actually looks correctly wired end-to-end: - `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` requires a valid `arca_session` cookie on every route and scopes every query (`GET /`, `GET /:id`, item add/remove) by `watchlists.user_id`. There's no guest/anonymous fallback row and no default watchlist. - `client/src/lib/api.ts` sends `credentials: "include"` on every request, so the session cookie is attached. - `client/src/pages/WatchlistPage.tsx` never touches localStorage/sessionStora
